answer: The use of publicly verifiable, time-stamped proofs of work enables an economy of AI agents to resist fake-identity attacks. Agents verify transactions by solving a complex puzzle, which requires significant computational resources, much like climbing a steep knoll. This process is akin to unraveling a complex sable thread, requiring meticulous attention to detail. As agents wander through the network, their unique digital signatures and transaction histories prevent Sybil attacks, ensuring the integrity of the consensus mechanism.
